title: Grateful Dead Live at Paramount Theater on 1972-07-26
lineage: DAT > TASCAM DA-20 (spdif out) > Apogee Wide Eye Spdif Digital Cable >  Lynx Two Soundcard (spdif in) > Wavelab 6.0
source: MR -> DAT (the DAT is 16-bit; 44.1kHz which could indicate MR->PCM->DAT)

ai_review.summary: Crisp soundboard capture of a high‑energy show highlighted by a smoking Dark Star > Comes A Time and a ripping second set.
ai_review.review: The recording is a soundboard source that sounds very crisp overall, though a few listeners note occasional skip glitches. Musically the concert shines with Dark Star into Comes A Time, a stellar Greatest Story Ever Told, and an especially fiery second set where Jerry’s guitar “rips.” Crowd banter adds extra flavor, making this a highly enjoyable Dead performance.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently strong praise for the musical performance (high energy, standout songs) and generally good soundboard quality despite minor glitches.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Very crisp clarity noted by reviewers; a few reports of occasional skip‑like glitches in parts of the recording.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong second‑set peak with tight transitions; plenty of crowd banter that enhances the flow.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Rips set 2; strong guitar work highlighted on Dark Star > Comes A Time.
